board.text:
PEWTER CITY
POKéMON GYM
LEADER: BROCK

npcs.name: Camp Coordinator
lines: Welcome to the Pewter training camp! Hit a board and it gives your Pokémon real EV training — the effort points behind its stats.
Pick a board by what it trains: GEODUDE gives DEFENSE, EKANS ATTACK, ZUBAT SPEED.
The board matches your Pokémon's level and refills every time you knock it down — keep hitting it as long as you like.
When you've had enough, open the pause menu and RUN.

npcs.name: Camper Ray
lines: Caught in a wild fight you don't want? Open the pause menu with Esc and pick RUN.
TRAINER battles refuse — you have to win or lose those.
The practice boards count as wild, so RUN is how you end a session.

npcs.name: Lass June
lines: See the disc on the ground? That's a ground move telegraphing where it will hit.
Jump while it shows and moves like EARTHQUAKE and MAGNITUDE miss you clean.
Watch for the disc, then jump — timing beats raw power.

npcs.name: Super Nerd Gil
lines: A burn halves your Attack and ticks off HP every beat.
Paralysis and sleep stop you acting at all — a bad status can lose a fight on its own.
Status lingers after the battle ends. A POKéMON CENTER heals it.

npcs.name: Youngster Ned
lines: Moves like GROWL lower one of the foe's stats for the rest of the fight.
They stack, so two GROWLs cut Attack twice as hard.
The drops wear off when the battle ends — hit hard while they last.

npcs.name: Youngster
lines: You can't go east to Route 3 without the Boulder Badge.
Beat Leader Brock at the Pewter Gym and come back!

npcs.name: Gym Guide
lines:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.

They're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.

But PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.

npcs.name: Museum Goer
lines: This is it, the MUSEUM.

You have to pay to get in, but it's
worth it. See you around!
